### 2.2 DPAS48

```{r data import}
# Read the DPAS48, 48 patients DPAS by 4 raters
dpas_0 <- read_excel(
  file.path(data_path, "DPAS48.xlsx")
)
```

#### 2.2.1 Column names to English

```{r}
# Step 1. Rename columns to English
dpas_1_colname <- dpas_0 |>
  rename(
    Patient_id = 患者,
    Rater = 监察人
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    # `rename_with` accepts function:
    # dplyr/purrr accept one-sided function, function has only the RHS
    # `~...` R shorthand for an anonymous function
    # `~` means: Define a function, and use `.x` as its input

    # `.x` represents the current input value passed to the function
    # Equivalent to:
    # function(.x) {
    #   paste0("Forehead", sub("^额", "", .x))
    # }

    # Inside the paste0:
    # for the current input column name .x
    # find 额 at the beginning of the string (^额)
    # and replace it with nothing ("")
    # leaving the rest of the column name unchanged.
    ~ paste0("Forehead", sub("^额", "", .x)),

    # select column start with `额`
    # followed by one or more digits
    matches("^额\\d+$")
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("Right_cheek", sub("^右", "", .x)),
    matches("^右\\d+$")
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("Left_cheek", sub("^左", "", .x)),
    matches("^左\\d+$")
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("Chin", sub("^下", "", .x)),
    matches("^下\\d+$")
  )
```

#### 2.2.2 Column re-valuePatient_id as character

```{r}
# Step 2. column `患者` as character
dpas_2_colvalue <- dpas_1_colname |>
  mutate(Patient_id = as.character(Patient_id))
```

#### 2.2.3 Long format

```{r}
# Step 3. Long format
# Long format
dpas_3_long <- dpas_2_colvalue |>
  pivot_longer(
    # columns to be converted to long format
    cols = 3:ncol(dpas_2_colvalue),
    names_to = "Position_metric",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) |>
  # Regex
  # (?<= : Positive lookbehind: look immediately behind the current position
  # \\D  : the immediate character behind the current position is a non-digit
  # (?=  : Positive lookahead: look immediately ahead of the current position
  # \\d  : the immediate character ahead of the current position is a digit
  # the regex engine tests positions (boundaries) in the string
  separate(
    Position_metric,
    into = c("Position", "Metric"),
    sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)",
    convert = TRUE
  )
```


### 2.3 Import HIS and calculate comorbidity: CCI and Elixhauser

#### 2.3.1 Read icd10_chn

```{r Read the ICD10_CHN}
icd10_chn<- read_excel("~/DPAS Reproducibility/data/ICD10_CHN.xlsx")
```


#### 2.3.2 Extract IPD HIS

```{r}
# extract IPD his comorbidity 
ipd_his <- extract_his(file_name = "IPD_HIS.xlsx", source = "ipd")
```

#### 2.3.3 Extract OPD HIS

```{r}
# extract opd his comorbidity
opd_his <- extract_his(file_name = "OPD_HIS.xlsx", source = "opd")
```

#### 2.3.4 Combine OPD and IPD HIS

```{r}
# combine ipd and opd
his <- rbind(ipd_his, opd_his)
```

#### 2.3.5 Calculate comorbidity index

##### 2.3.5.1 Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI)

```{r charlson and elixhauser comorbidity index}
# charlson
charlson <- comorbidity(x = his, 
                        id = "id_number", 
                        code = "raw_icd", 
                        map = "charlson_icd10_quan", 
                        assign0 = TRUE) 

charlson

cci_score <- score(charlson, weights = "charlson", assign0 = TRUE)

cci_score <- data.frame(
   = charlson$Patient_id, 
  cci_score = cci_score
)
```


```{r}

# elixhauser 
elixhauser <- comorbidity(
  x = his,
  id = "Patient_id",
  code = "raw_icd",
  map = "elixhauser_icd10_quan",
  assign0 = TRUE
)

# Calculate the van Walraven weighted score
elixhauser_score <- score(
  elixhauser,
  weights = "vw",
  assign0 = TRUE
)

# Inspect the results
elixhauser_score <- data.frame(
  Patient_id = elixhauser$Patient_id, 
  elixhauser_score = elixhauser_score
)
```

```{r Merge DPAS and pt_info}
# Create canonical dataset, dat_long
# and join patient info
dat_long <- clean_pt |>

# data class of each column
dat_long <- dat_long %>%
  mutate(

    Sex        = factor(Sex),
    Age        = as.numeric(Age), # already numeric → no-op, kept for clarity
```

```{r revalue}
# Revalue metrics

# Revalue sex
dat_long <- dat_long |>
  mutate(Sex = case_when(
    Sex == "Female" ~ "女",
    Sex == "Male" ~ "男"
  ))




```

## Merge dat_long and comorbidity score and stratify cci

```{r merge cci}
dat_long <- dat_long |>
  left_join(cci_score)
```


```{r}
dat_long <- dat_long |>
  mutate(
    cci_strata = case_when(
      cci_score <= 1 ~ "≤1",
      cci_score <= 3 ~ "2-3",
      cci_score > 3  ~ ">3",
    ),
    cci_strata = factor(
      cci_strata, 
      levels = c("≤1", "2-3", ">3"), 
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```


## 目的

光老化皮损需要可靠的量化评估[@zhaoNoninvasiveAssessmentMethods2025]。本研究通过组内相关系数分析[@IntraclassCorrelationCoefficient]，评估皮肤镜光老化量表（Dermoscopic Photoaging Scale, DPAS）[@isikDevelopmentSkinAging2013a]由皮肤科不同职级人员实施的可靠性。同时探索西北高原地区光老化皮损特征。

## 方法

随机48名门诊患者，采集前额，左右颧骨和下巴正中的皮肤镜照片，按照DPAS量表要求，有科室四个职级人员（副主任医师、主治医师、住院医师、护士）分别读片，评估患者光老化皮损。

1.  不同光老化皮损的分布特征。

2.  评估不同职级人员使用DPAS量表的可靠性和重现性。

3.  逻辑回归探索性别、部位和光老化皮损类型的关系。

## 结果

### 1. 患者基线：


```{r Table 1}
# Calculate Table 1
table1_df <- dat_long |>
  select(Patient_id, Sex, Age, cci_strata) |>
  distinct(Patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = Sex,
    include = c(Age, cci_strata),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany"
  ) |>
  add_p(
    test = list(
      Age ~ "t.test",
      cci_strata ~ "fisher.test"
    )
  ) |>
  as_tibble()

# Render Table 1 in MS Word
table1_df |>
  flextable() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  hline(
    i = nrow(table1_df),
    border = fp_border(width = 2),
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  set_caption("患者性别、年龄及合并症负担") |>
  autofit()
```

### 2. 不同光老化皮损的发生特征

DPAS量表的常见皮损见下图：


```{r include lesion image}
knitr::include_graphics("~/DPAS Reproducibility/images/DPAS10Lesions.png")
```


```{r metric by sex,fig.width=7, fig.asp=.618, out.width="100%"}
score_sex_position_metric <- dat_long |>
  group_by(Sex, Position, Metric) |>
  summarise(n = sum(Score) / 4) |>
  mutate(pct = n / 48)

# Remove `皮肤萎缩`
score_sex_position_metric <- score_sex_position_metric |>
  filter(!Metric == "皮肤萎缩")


g <- ggplot(
  score_sex_position_metric,
  aes(x = fct_rev(Metric), y = pct, fill = Sex)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    hjust = -0.1, # push labels just past the bar tip
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete_qualitative(palette = "Harmonic") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), # room for labels at the end
    limits = c(0, 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "不同光老化皮损类型在男女四个部位的发生率",
    x = "光老化类型",
    y = "发生率",
    color = "性别"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(. ~ Position) +
  
  # Font size will not change with the plot size
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

g
```

如上图，毛细血管扩张、色斑，脂溢性角化和深层皱纹和浅表皱纹是常见光老化特征，男女存在不同的皮损类型。


```{r total score}
dat_total_rater <- dat_long |>
  group_by(Patient_id, Rater, Sex, Age) |>
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # .groups gives summarise() explicit control 
    # over the grouping structure that will be passed to subsequent dplyr operations.
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### 3. DPAS总分的评估重现性


```{r total icc}
icc_total <- calculate_total_icc(dat_total_rater)

icc_result <- as.data.frame(icc_total$results)

icc_result <- icc_result |>
  filter(type == "ICC2") %>%
  select(ICC, p, `lower bound`, `upper bound`)

icc_result$p <- "<0.001"


icc_result |>
  flextable() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  hline(
    i = nrow(icc_result),
    border = fp_border(width = 2),
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  set_caption("四个评估人对患者DPAS总分的ICC可靠性") |>
  autofit()
```


ICC(2,1) = 0.945，表明不同评估人在DPAS总分上高度一致，约94.5%的相对评分变异反映患者间的差异，而与测量误差和评估人差异有关的变异仅为5.5%。

### 4.患者分项皮损的评估重现性


```{r metric specific score}
dat_metric_specific_rater <- dat_long |>
  group_by(Patient_id, Rater, Sex, Age, Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r metric icc}
icc_metric <- calculate_metric_icc(dat_metric_specific_rater)

icc_metric$P <- "P < 0.001"

# Remove `皮肤萎缩`
icc_metric <- icc_metric |>
  filter(!Metric %in% "皮肤萎缩")

# Remove the F, df1, df2 value in icc_metric
icc_metric <- icc_metric |>
  select(-`F`, -df1, -df2)

icc_metric |>
  flextable() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  border_remove() |>
  hline(
    i = 1,
    border = officer::fp_border(width = 1),
    part = "header"
  ) |>
  hline_bottom(
    border = officer::fp_border(width = 2),
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  set_caption("四个评估人对患者分项皮损的ICC可靠性") |>
  autofit()
```


同上，针对不同的光老化皮损类型，不同评估人之间的评估高度重现。

### 5. 混合效应逻辑回归

#### fit1_all_in

```{r}
fit1 <- glmer(
  Score ~ Metric * (Sex + Age + cci_score) +
    Position + Rater +
    (1 | Patient_id),
  data = dat_long,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
```

```{r}
isSingular(fit1)
```

```{r}
summary(fit1)
```
#### fit1_all_in maxfun 200000

optimizer (bobyqa) convergence code: 1 (bobyqa -- maximum number of function evaluations exceeded), try 

The challenges are complex interaction terms. 

```{r}
ctrl <- glmerControl(
  optimizer = "bobyqa",
  optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
)

fit1_200000 <- glmer(
  Score ~ Metric * (Sex + Age + cci_score) +
    Position + Rater +
    (1 | Patient_id),
  data = dat_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = ctrl
)
```

```{r}
isSingular(fit1_200000)
```

```{r}
summary(fit1_200000)
```

#### fit1_all_in nloptwrap

```{r}
fit1_nloptwrap <- glmer(
  Score ~ Metric * (Sex + Age + cci_score) +
    Position + Rater +
    (1 | Patient_id),
  data = dat_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
    calc.derivs = TRUE
  )
)
```


```{r}
isSingular(fit1_nloptwrap)
```

```{r}
summary(fit1_nloptwrap)
```
##### fit1_nloptwrap diagnosis

```{r}
fit1_nloptwrap@optinfo$optimizer

fit1_nloptwrap@optinfo$conv$opt
```

```{r}
#compare the estimate of fit1_200000 and fit1_nloptwrap
cbind(
  bobyqa = fixef(fit1_200000),
  nloptwrap = fixef(fit1_nloptwrap)
      )

logLik(fit1_200000)
logLik(fit1_nloptwrap)
```

```{r}
# Compare available optimizers
af <- allFit(fit1_nloptwrap)

# Summarise optimizer results
summary(af)

# Extract fixed-effect estimates from successful fits
af_summary <- summary(af)

af_summary$fixef
af_summary$llik
af_summary$sdcor
af_summary$which.OK
```

##### fit1_all_in nloptwrap post hoc

###### Age

```{r}
# Estimate the Elixhauser slope for each lesion type
age_effect <- emtrends(
  fit1_nloptwrap,
  ~ Metric,
  var = "Age"
)

# Test whether the CCI slope differs from zero
summary(
  age_effect,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```

###### Sex

```{r}
# Estimate diabetes effects separately for each lesion
sex_effect <- emmeans(
  fit1_nloptwrap,
  ~ Sex | Metric
)

# Compare diabetes = 1 with diabetes = 0 within each lesion
sex_or <- pairs(
  sex_effect,
  reverse = TRUE
)

# Report odds ratios, 95% CIs, and P values
summary(
  sex_effect,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "holm"
)
```


###### cci_score

```{r}
# Estimate the Elixhauser slope for each lesion type
cci_effect <- emtrends(
  fit1_nloptwrap,
  ~ Metric,
  var = "cci_score"
)

# Test whether the CCI slope differs from zero
summary(
  cci_effect,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```
